messages:
Alex Chen: noticing a reconnect surge in eu-west-1 at 10:12 UTC, ~2.8x normal. Any infra changes?
Priya Nair: saw the panel spike. p95 open/close up but backend error rates flat.
Jamal Ortiz: logs show proxy returning 204 mid-session then client reconnects. snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T10:11:57Z] proxy=gw-12 session=sess-9 resp=204 empty-body
[2026-03-21T10:11:58Z] client-reconnect session=sess-9 attempt=1
```
Marta Kowalski: We rolled a proxy config at 10:05 to shorten keepalive-ttl on low-memory nodes. Could be draining behavior.
Alex Chen: tracer-bot, fetch a trace for one affected session.
tracer-bot: trace://1800101111-xyz -> proxy drain hook sent 204 w/o session-tag; sticky lease persisted but connection closed.
Priya Nair: console UX issue: many traces show probe-origin missing so filtering by config is hard.
Jamal Ortiz: billing note: some reconnects later produce duplicate billing events. Suspect resume path re-emit.
Marta Kowalski: short-term: revert keepalive-ttl change on low-memory pool. UI: add proxy-drain_reason and response-code columns.
infra-bot: deploy "revert-keepalive-ttl-lowmem" started at 10:28 UTC by Priya N.
Priya Nair: revert done 10:34 UTC, reconnects back to baseline by 10:36. Filed INF-2001 with screenshots.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll add resume handler idempotency and a meter assertion to avoid double billing. PR ETA today.
Marta Kowalski: I'll draft a short postmortem and backlog the UI trace-link + response-code filter.
Alex Chen: Nice quick rollback. Follow-ups: e2e test for proxy 204 mid-ttl, routing sim case, and a dashboard heatmap for proxy-204 by node id.
Priya Nair: Filed DD-402 for heatmap and assigned to eng-sre.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Closing loop unless anyone has open items.
